fields.assessment_notes: Tilted Gaming now has stronger current-operation support from its official events page, which confirms the Cerritos location, current store hours, Discord routing, in-store signup policy, and Magic as part of its automatically updated monthly schedule ecosystem. Existing Wizards/EventLink data already covers the Friday 6 PM casual Commander anchor. The main cleanup is duplicate-series risk: keep the detailed Friday Night Magic Casual Tilted Commanders row active and mark the older Tilted Commanders row inactive as a duplicate/superseded snapshot. Tilted is very close and practically relevant, but the public positioning reads as a competitive multi-TCG hub, so Commander table culture, proxy norms, and solo-arrival friendliness still need a bounded Discord/social check before it becomes a top personal recommendation.

operations.reason: Update Tilted with current official events/source-routing evidence and duplicate-event interpretation.

fields.assessment_notes: Grails Gone Wild remains a status-conflicted planning lead. Wizards/EventLink already has a Sunday casual Commander row with useful casual-pod language, and TCGplayer supports active online MTG/collectibles commerce. BBB and directory surfaces support physical-business identity at the Torrance address, but a Yelp-derived map surface flags the location as closed and the obvious public footprint is stronger for collectibles/online commerce than for current in-person Magic community. Keep the existing Commander row visible as a source-backed lead, but do not treat Grails as a reliable personal planning venue without same-day status verification.

operations.reason: Replace Grails discovery placeholder with an explicit status-conflict assessment.

fields.assessment_notes: B.Y.O.GAMES is a nontraditional but interesting East LA gaming-lounge lead. Existing Wizards/EventLink rows already cover Tuesday and Wednesday Commander with unusually useful details: casual/warm-up/free-play language, four-player pod minimum, Bracket 3-4, no infinites, Rule Zero encouragement, and paid tournament structure. Public review/community surfaces describe a real gaming lounge with video games, card-game space, tournaments, friendly staff, and community/hangout value. SoCal Gaming Expo identifies BYO as a tabletop/MTG organizer for Limited and Commander, but that June 2026 event has passed and should stay source/evidence-only. The main caution is status/source conflict and distance: verify current operation and event details before driving there.
